Antes pensaba que mi piel necesitaba más productos… pero descubrí que la hidratación era lo más importante 🤍 A mi piel le encanta el gel de aloe vera porque deja una sensación fresca y calmante. Últimamente estoy mezclando gel de aloe vera con Mixsoon PDRN Eye Cream para crear mi propia crema cápsula hidratante DIY. Me encanta cómo se siente mi piel: fresca, hidratada y con un glow natural ✨ A veces no se trata de usar más productos.. sino de encontrar lo que tu piel realmente necesita. Crea tu crema de boba 🫧 💡 Tip de skincare: El gel de aloe vera combina muy bien con ingredientes hidratantes y calmantes como PDRN, ácido hialurónico, pantenol y centella. ⚠️ Ten cuidado con ingredientes fuertes como AHA, BHA, retinol y vitamina C en alta concentración, porque pueden irritar las pieles sensibles. #skincare #aolevera #glowingskin #koreanskincare #skincareroutine

Annndddd here’s the method cus I hate to be annoying: 1. Azelaic acid + a retinoid 2. Barrier serum twice per day 3. Moisturiser AND sunscreen for max hydration 4. Double cleansing with an oil based cleanser that matches my specific criteria (too long to explain here, but there are some specific ingredients I recommend avoiding if you're acne-prone that will help you be much more successful with oil cleansers) 5. LED mask Rinse and repeat for the next five years. My whole method is based around the fundamentals of skin never changing. Skincare companies can release tonnes of new products that are all new and exciting. That doesn't mean our skin actually needs them. In fact, they rarely do. A deep dive into the method is pinned on my profile. I also made a completely free downloadable guide on how to introduce a retinoid, plus I have a 45-minute YouTube video coming out on Sunday on how to use a retinoid azelaic acid for MAX results. 💚 #skincare #skincaretips

Skincare at 51: Part 1 - Cleansing I try to keep my routine pretty simple, but explaining the whole thing in one video? Suddenly it feels very complicated. 😂 So I’m breaking it down step by step. For cleansing, I alternate between a double wash with a milky cleanser and a gentle exfoliator. On exfoliation nights, I skip my retinol night cream because my skin does not need both at once. The products I use are linked in my ShopMy, but this isn’t about finding one “perfect” product. It’s about finding what works for your skin.
